subject: SOC 2 / CAIQ: key custody & operator snapshot request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security-compliance@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / CAIQ - key custody and operator snapshot

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking the time on our security intake call last week. As part of our CAIQ and SOC 2 evidence collection, the audit team has asked for the following artifacts related to encryption and key management: 

- A current "operator snapshot" for KMS/HSM operators (who has access, roles, and separation-of-duty notes).
- Recent key rotation logs (last 12 months) for the tenant-encrypted keys used by our environment.
- HSM attestation or seal proof showing the device firmware/serial and seal status at time of last rotation.

Can you provide these items or let me know the right contacts and an estimated delivery date? If there are any items that require redaction or a separate NDA, flag them and we can coordinate through procurement.

Appreciate the help — our SOC 2 deadline is Oct 6, so a delivery the week of Sep 25 would be ideal.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Security Programs Manager
AcmeCorp

--

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 / CAIQ - key custody and operator snapshot

Folks — forwarding Acme's ask. They want operator-level access records, rotation logs for the last 12 months, and an HSM attestation snapshot. Deadline preference: week of Sep 25.

Notes/questions: 
- This will likely require pulling operator role mappings from IAM and combing HSM operator logs.
- Confirm whether the HSM seal file we received last rotation is sufficient or they want a fresh attestation.
- If anything is sensitive (personnel PII), we'll provide an access-restricted Drive link and redacted PDFs.

Ben, could you take lead on generating the operator snapshot and rotation extract? Laura/Marissa, please advise on redaction and compliance packaging. Naomi, FYI on timing and any legal constraints.

Thanks — Jonas

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 / CAIQ - key custody and operator snapshot

Jonas / team — I can assemble this. Quick status and plan: 

1) Operator snapshot (kms_operator_snapshot.pdf) — will include operator principal names, RBAC roles, last-activity timestamps, and separation-of-duty notes. I will pull from IAM + HSM operator logs and scrub personal contact info.

2) Rotation logs (rotation_log_extract.csv) — export of rotation events for tenant keys (UTC timestamps, key ID, initiated_by, event_type). I will include a checksum and a short README explaining the column mapping.

3) HSM attestation (hsm_seal_attestation.txt) — we have the vendor-signed seal from the last ceremony (2028-03-14). Need confirmation whether the vendor signature + serial is adequate or if Acme requires live attestation over a secure channel.

Timing: I can produce drafts by Wed Sep 20 EOD. Laura/Marissa — please advise on redaction thresholds (do we remove initiator usernames or map to role-only?).

Attachments will be shared to a restricted Drive folder (link below) and I will send the PDFs to Acme with restricted view.

Ben
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms_operator_snapshot.pdf (draft), rotation_log_extract.csv (partial), hsm_seal_attestation.txt (original vendor seal stub)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: security-compliance@acmecorp.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 18:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / CAIQ - key custody and operator snapshot

Samantha — thanks for the request. Attached are the artifacts you requested (PDF/CSV/TXT) and a short README in the Drive folder that explains columns and redaction. Summary below.

Summary of delivered artifacts (attached and in shared folder):
- kms_operator_snapshot.pdf — operator roles, last activity timestamps, and separation-of-duty comments. Personal email addresses redacted; roles preserved.
- rotation_log_extract.csv — rotation events for tenant keys, 2027-09-01 through 2028-09-01 (UTC). Columns: timestamp_utc, key_id, action, initiated_role, change_summary, checksum.
- hsm_seal_attestation.txt — vendor-signed attestation file from last ceremony (2028-03-14) including HSM model and serial.

Drive link (restricted view): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHIjklmn0 (ACME evidence folder)
HubSpot reference: ACME-98127

If the auditor needs a live attestation or a notarized vendor statement, let us know and we can coordinate with the HSM vendor for a signed live attestation. Otherwise, please confirm receipt and whether these artifacts satisfy CAIQ/SOC 2 evidence bank.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Security Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms_operator_snapshot.pdf, rotation_log_extract.csv, hsm_seal_attestation.txt
